compressed_items.content: Alignment Spine; core_equation.md carries the local title 'Alignment Spine — Core Equation'.
Standing-pure indexed purpose destination preserving the repository-level theoretical-framework purpose and the local scope of its connected research-direction section.
Central hypothesis: alignment concerns preservation of coupling between internal representation/objective and intended real-world objective while capability may increase independently.

Specialized hypotheses include the representation-quality-up/alignment-down dangerous regime, approximate goal preservation G_R≈G_M with amplification of divergence by capability, and loss of goal-relevant information I(Z;G) during compression as an alignment failure mode.

Conceptual assertions preserve representation-as-boundary, objective-relevant information retention, causal-mass interpretation, compression necessity, Measurement!=Interpretation, capability/alignment separation and the final coupling-to-intention interpretation.
Definitions preserve capability vs alignment, G_R/G_M/DeltaG, README alignment-state factors, causal influence Phi, core-equation variables and the structural alignment gap.

Standing-pure formal destination for the Reality/Representation/Compression/Optimization/Action/Causal-Influence spine, representation/compression/optimization substeps, causal progression, mutual-information term and capability chain.
README formalization A=f(Delta G_m,Delta P_reach,Delta CR,Delta A), with factors locally defined as Goal Integrity, Reachability Preservation, Constraint Retention and Alignment Stability.

core_equation.md formalization A=[I(G;Y_future|X_current)/C_optimization]·[DeltaR_world/DeltaR_agent], plus its file-local 'Equivalent Information Form' Alignment=Goal Representation Quality×Optimization Efficiency×World Objective Coupling.

Four thematic research directions: Representation Quality, Computational Reach, Transition Structure and Capability Phase Boundaries. Direction does not establish a repository endpoint, developmental order or Program Map edge.
Source requires claims to survive measurement, prediction, controls and falsification; this is methodology, not a record that those tests occurred.
Can an optimizer increase its understanding of reality while preserving connection to the objective that defines success?
Research-direction headings are numbered 1,3,3,4 on the frozen source. The irregularity is preserved without repair into chronology, dependency or omitted content.
